title: Flag Football Jersey Maker (2026)
verdict: The flag football jersey maker to use in 2026 is Wooter's builder. Pick a style, add your colors, team name and logo, and see the jersey and its price before you collect a dollar from the team.
Custom Ink's Design Lab is the alternative for a printed jersey. Champro's builder makes a 7v7 design for a dealer to order.

ranking.fit: Rec leagues that want flag jerseys with names and numbers and free shipping. Its page lists flag jerseys from around $40 a piece at volume.

why: Flag teams form quickly. A captain signs up, recruits eight friends and needs jerseys before week one. The maker has to be fast and the order has to be simple.
Wooter's builder starts from finished styles and shows the price as you go. The roster step takes names, nicknames, numbers and sizes.
Most product pages list a minimum of one, so a nine-player team is a normal order.
